title: Squalene Quantification using Nile Red Staining
author: Sebastian ST Triesch
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zucf6sw

steps.title: Prepare and Adjust Culture
steps.instruction: Adjust the Synechocystis culture to a specific optical density and divide into experimental and control groups.

substeps.instruction: Measure the OD at 750 nm of 1-2 ml Synechocystis culture.
Adjust the culture to 2 ml with an OD (750 nm) of 0.5 using BG-11 media.
Split the adjusted culture into two 1 ml portions: one for Nile Red staining and one as a negative control.

steps.title: Stain Samples with Nile Red
steps.instruction: Apply Nile Red stain to the experimental sample and DMSO to the control sample.

substeps.instruction: Stain one 1 ml portion with Nile Red in DMSO to a final concentration of 5 µg/ml.
Add an equivalent volume of DMSO to the unstained control sample.
Ensure gloves and lab coat are worn to prevent DMSO from staining skin and cloth.

steps.title: Incubate Samples
steps.instruction: Incubate the cultures for 60 minutes in the dark.

steps.title: Centrifuge and Remove Supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples and carefully remove the liquid phase.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge all samples for 5 minutes at 8000 xg.
Carefully discard the supernatant by pipetting, ensuring the pellet is not resuspended and cells are not lost.

steps.title: Wash Pellets
steps.instruction: Perform a double wash of the pellets using BG-11 media.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend all pellets in 1 ml BG-11 media.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 8000 xg and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet again in 1 ml BG-11 media.

steps.title: Prepare 96-Well Plate
steps.instruction: Distribute the cultures into a 96-well plate for measurement.

substeps.instruction: Fill wells with 200 µl of culture per well.
Ensure there are four wells per sample.

steps.title: Measure OD and Fluorescence
steps.instruction: Use a plate reader to measure the optical density and fluorescence of each well.

substeps.instruction: Measure the OD (750 nm) of each well.
Measure Nile Red fluorescence using Excitation: 510 nm and Emission: 660 nm.

steps.title: Analyze Data
steps.instruction: Process the fluorescence data to determine squalene quantification.

substeps.instruction: Normalize the fluorescence of each well to its respective OD.
Subtract the fluorescence of the negative control (without Nile Red) from the fluorescence of the stained sample.
Compare the results to wild type Nile Red stained fluorescence.

steps.title: Optional: Check Free Nile Red
steps.instruction: Verify the quantity of free Nile Red in the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Keep the removed supernatant from washing steps to check for free Nile Red.
Optionally, repeat washing steps until no more Nile Red is detected in the supernatant.
